name: Syncy Lite – Integration for Square Payments & Sync For WooCommerce
author: Techspawn

sections.description:
Syncy Lite is a powerful WordPress plugin that integrates your WooCommerce store with Square, enabling seamless product synchronization, inventory management, and payment processing.

Core Features:

  • 📦 Sync WooCommerce products with Square
    Automatically sync your WooCommerce products with Square for easy management.

  • 💳 Accept payments via Square Credit Card on your WooCommerce store
    Process payments securely via Square, directly in your WooCommerce store.

  • 🔄 Sync product stock levels across both platforms
    Keep product stock levels up-to-date across both WooCommerce and Square.

  • ⚙️ Easy setup with Square API credentials integration
    Simple configuration with easy-to-follow steps for setting up your Square API credentials.

    • 🏷️ Bulk product sync from WooCommerce to Square
      Sync multiple products at once from your WooCommerce store to Square in just a few clicks.

Pro Features (Syncy Pro):

  • 📊 Manage WooCommerce orders with Square order syncing
    Synchronize WooCommerce orders with Square for smooth order management.

  • 🔄 Advanced stock management and sync options
    Get more control over syncing stock levels with advanced options.

  • 💸 Custom payment settings with Square
    Customize your Square payment settings for enhanced control over transactions.

  • 📊 Reporting & Analytics for sales, inventory, and customers
    Gain insights into your sales and inventory performance with detailed reports.

  • ⚡ Priority support for Pro users
    Get faster, priority support when you upgrade to syncy Pro.

  • ⏰ Scheduled & Realtime sync for automatic product updates
    Automatically update product data with scheduled syncs.

    Learn more about Syncy Pro at: Syncy Pro

External Services

This plugin connects to Square’s API for payment processing and syncing orders. Data is sent to Square whenever a transaction is processed or stock levels are synced.

API base URL: https://connect.squareup.com/v2 (live) and https://connect.squareupsandbox.com/v2 (sandbox).

For more details, see:
– Square API Terms of Service
– Square Privacy Policy
sections.installation:
1. Download the syncy Lite plugin zip file.
  2. Go to your WordPress dashboard, navigate to Plugins > Add New.
  3. Click Upload Plugin, select the downloaded zip file, and click Install Now.
  4. After installation, click Activate to activate the plugin.
  5. Go to syncy > Settings > General and enter your Square API credentials to begin the setup.
sections.faq:
How do I upgrade to syncy Pro?

To unlock the Pro features, go to WooCommerce > Settings > syncy and click Upgrade to Pro. Follow the prompts to purchase and enable the Pro version.

Do I need a Square account?

Yes, you need a valid Square account to process payments and sync products. You can create the account at : https://squareup.com/us/en.

What are the steps required to use this plugin?

For all information regarding syncy Lite please view our documentation at : https://techspawn.com/docs/syncy-woocommerce-square-sync-and-payments
